text:
Nina H.: quick one 12pm visitor drop-in: 3 artists coming to install a small umbrella mobile in the lobby. they said installation takes ~30m and one crate (ART-PLINTH) will arrive at 11:40am. can we do temporary badges + move the couch for a clearer install zone?
Sam (People Ops): noted. vendor badge rules apply. do we have COI for the install crew? :umbrella:
Chris M.: im on it. vendor name: "MobileCanopy Collective". COI uploaded to `vendor_coi/` as `MobileCanopy_COI_20260319.pdf`.
Frontdesk Bot: Delivery alert: package "ART-PLINTH" for "Nina H." ETA 11:40am via UPS. Staging suggestion: loading dock -> lobby staging area. Max temp badges per print: 10.
Theo (Facilities): couch can be moved to the east bench for 1 hour. ill ask AV to hold the tall ladder and a plywood base. need someone to meet the courier at 11:40.
Nina H.: i can meet the courier at 11:40. can front desk print 3 visitor badges with company = "MobileCanopy" and pronouns? template `visitor-minimal-v2.pdf` ok.
Sam (People Ops): front desk will print. @Frontdesk Bot can you reserve the east bench & note the ladder request?
Frontdesk Bot: East bench reserved 11:30-13:00. Ladder and plywood base reserved from AV. Please upload guest list to `visitor-uploads/`. Badges will be printed on arrival unless pre-uploaded.
Chris M.: guest list uploaded as `mobilecanopy_guests_2026.csv`. also one artist requested a quick plug for a CPAP machine nearby during install (medical). can we ensure a nearby outlet and a low-noise corner?
Theo (Facilities): we can reserve outlet at the east bench corner and put a small barrier. i'll coordinate with AV for low-noise support.
Sam (People Ops): seat swap poll: moving couch frees 3 chairs in lobby. react with :hand: if you need a seat during 12:00-12:45.
Nina H.: reminder for courier pickup: label the crate `ART-PLINTH-NINA-3123456789` and tag in delivery log. also please keep the crate locked until artists open it.
Frontdesk Bot: Delivery log entry created: `ART-PLINTH` accepted at loading dock by Nina H. at 11:40. Photo placeholder: `mail-photos/3123456789.jpg`.
Chris M.: thanks all. will introduce the artists at 12:00 so badges can be released. one more: artists asked if we have a small fridge for a prop (non-food). is pantry B available?
Sam (People Ops): pantry B ok for non-food prop storage for 30 mins. label `MOBILECANOPY_PROP` and note in logs. checklist: 1) COI on file, 2) badges printed `visitor-minimal-v2.pdf`, 3) couch moved to east bench, 4) crate staged and labelled, 5) ladder & plywood reserved, 6) outlet reserved, 7) small fridge in pantry B available. ping me if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
Nina H.: perfect. see you at 11:40. :wave:
